name: Nodes & P2P Mesh
description: Decentralized peer-to-peer mesh coordinator: connects multiple Nuxiva nodes across the local network.
capabilities: Print Screen key screenshots saved to the shared folder, queued when the network is down

settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT: Screenshot with the Print Screen key, saved to the shared folder (only that key is read)
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_TARGET: Destination: mounted folder (e.g. /mnt/nuxiva) or smb://address/share (empty = the server's share)
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_SUBDIR: Subfolder of the share (up to 4 levels)
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_MASK: Masked areas in thousandths of the screen: x,y,width,height separated by semicolons
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS: Keep screenshots for N days (∞ = never delete by age)
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_BLOCK_LOCKED: Do not capture while the screen is locked
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_BLOCK_GUESTS: Do not capture while guests are present
settings.NUXIVA_SCREENSHOT_NOTICE: Show a notification on every capture

screenshot_voice.queued: I took the screenshot but the shared folder {folder} is not answering: it stays queued and I will send it on my own
screenshot_voice.blocked: I did not take the screenshot: privacy blocks it, the screen is locked or guests are present
screenshot_voice.failed: The screenshot failed: the screen could not be captured
screenshot_voice.disabled: Screenshots are off: turn them on in the Nodes panel
screenshot_voice.no_target: There is no folder for screenshots: set it in the Nodes panel
screenshot_voice.remote: Voice screenshots work on this server's display; on other PCs press Print Screen
screenshot_voice.service: The screenshot service is not running on this server: it starts with the next update
screenshot_voice.timeout: I asked for the screenshot but the service did not answer in time
